hypothesis: A partially pooled home-court deviation for each franchise improves next-season game-margin prediction beyond one global home effect.

model.team_home_parameterization: one global signed home column plus 30 signed home-team deviation columns; solve a KKT system imposing an exposure-weighted zero mean on team deviations so global and team penalties remain distinct
model.season_scoring_environment: remove each training-season mean before fitting player effects

restrictions: Select the team penalty on 2019-2023 only, then score only the selected candidate on reused 2024-2026 diagnostics.
No travel, altitude, rest, time decay, team strength, or score-state feature enters this experiment.
Team deviations are nuisance controls, not franchise talent ratings.
forbidden_interpretation: A team-specific home coefficient is not causal altitude, travel, crowd, referee, or arena evidence. This reused historical experiment cannot promote a public model.
